phase-428 W5 (2026-09-06) — ledgering a recorded sweep finding. RANKED-10, with the recorded form CORRECTED in two places. The row above describes a functioning setter; it is not one, on the standalone node.

The dead end is one level down: `PublisherInfo::qos` is never READ. `grep -n '\.qos' packages/core/nros-node/src/node.rs` yields exactly four hits — the two builder writes and the two struct-literal copies. `publisher_topic_info` returns a `TopicInfo` with name/type/hash/domain and no QoS, and `StandaloneNode` has no transport at all.

A `pub` field on a `pub` struct would never have triggered `dead_code` anyway — so the compiler was not silenced here; it was never going to speak.

HOW A USER FINDS OUT: SILENTLY WRONG. The builder chains, returns `Self`, and the QoS is never applied. Same shape as the `NodeOptions` setters RFC-0089's hazard section names.
